description: This PHP file defines a function 'getMyFaq' that retrieves and displays a list of FAQs for a module in a CRM system, including database queries, view rendering, and search functionality.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Class used for handling custom view logic in the CRM, instantiated to determine default views.

classes.name: Faq
classes.description: Class representing FAQ entity, used to instantiate FAQ objects within the list retrieval.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating list view headers and entries for displaying data tables.

methods.name: getMyFaq
methods.description: Retrieves a list of FAQs based on current views and user preferences, returning module info, headers, entries, and search query URL.

methods.name: getMyFaqSearch
methods.description: Adds search criteria to a request array for filtering FAQs, specifically filtering out 'Obsolete' status entries.
